Definition: from G2339; to hunt (an animal), i.e. (figuratively) to carp at:--catch.
BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, thēreúō means to hunt, to catch. In Luke 11:54, seeking to catch something out of his mouth.
TheologicalSignificance: Men lying in wait to catch a word from Jesus' mouth remind me that hostility often hides behind careful questions.
